note: Palette-swap player action sprites (interact / tool animations): frames <style>/<action><k>/<DIR>, each with its own rect and anchor (the feet). markers.<part> lists the six marker tones dark -> light and then the outline colour, exactly as in player.json; the game recolours them (docs/11). actions.<name> gives frames, fps and loop; carry plays like walking, cycle 0,3,1,3,0,4,2,4 (0 idle, 1 walk1, 2 walk2, 3 step1, 4 step2). Tools use fixed (non-marker) ramps and never gold.
